searchText: Hi, has a date been set for the deposit contract launch? Are we all set for the deposit contract? No communication atm and nobody on /r/ethfinance or Twitter etc seems to know what is going on. I suspect the silence is a bad sign...? As an fyi this is the type of stuff we're seeing on social media and it's only going to get worse "I shut my validator down (exited formally) because it's it's become a shitshow and because I don't feel like paying VULTR anymore. Medalla ran for plenty long enough. Dress rehearsal #2 was fine. And so.... ? What's the plan from here? Do nothing until it's so late in the year we decide to just take the rest of the year off?" I can assure you that everyone is working their ass off you can quote me on that **dankrad**
